title: Static Broad-Lobed-Abdomen Leaf-Leg Insect
description: One newly authored whole static stylised leaf insect. Six complete outward bent legs have broad irregularly widened leaf-like upper portions narrowing into fine lower limbs and finite grounded toe ends. Two fine tapering antennae and small lateral eyes complete the body. All numeric body and limb stations are newly authored, not a green cicada with roof wings removed or a mantis with its forearms deleted. One whole animal model zero scenes.
